pages.text: Lightning, chaos, desert - these slow, primitive worm-like creatures give off a constant current full of malice, and they hold nothing but hostility for outsiders.$(br)Your ranks lacked a mighty creature that wields lightning the way they do; by binding a Lightning Worm to your own storm you made a Lightning Worm servant that answers to you.

Lightning, thunderstorm, all of it - this primeval worm has woven lightning into its very way of life, and that surging current is sure to shine in your service.$(br)You can hold $(item)Redstone Dust$() and right-click a Lightning Worm to heal it.
